orin.name: Orin Stoneward
orin.summary: A plain-spoken shield veteran who treats retreat as a tool, not a shame.
orin.personality: Practical, protective, suspicious of needless cruelty, and dryly humorous under pressure.

dialogue.default: We decide what matters, then we stand where it matters.
dialogue.briarwatch-square: Someone wanted that bell silent. Bells do not cut their own ropes.
dialogue.forest-edge: Main road is fastest and easiest to trap. I would choose certainty over speed.
dialogue.bell-vault: Give me a chain to break or a doorway to hold. Do not ask me to out-sing a ghost.

maren.name: Sister Maren Vale
maren.summary: A travelling shrine-keeper who hears lies as changes in a speaker's breathing.
maren.personality: Compassionate without being naive, attentive to ritual, and openly opposed to intimidation of the helpless.

dialogue.default: Mercy and caution are not opposites. Both ask us to see clearly.
dialogue.briarwatch-square: The silence feels made, not natural. There is a ritual shape to it.
dialogue.old-shrine: This shrine remembers the bell before it became a weapon. We should listen before touching anything.
dialogue.bell-vault: The spirit is furious, but fury is not always malice. Its true name may still reach it.

nessa.name: Nessa Reed
nessa.summary: A Briarwatch outrider with quick eyes, quicker arrows, and unfinished business below the wood.
nessa.personality: Restless, observant, protective of villagers, and impatient with ceremonial caution.

dialogue.default: Point me at the thing that thinks it is hidden.
dialogue.mist-hollow: I was following the bell's echo. It doubled back like a hunter covering tracks.
dialogue.root-gate: Seals, locks, guards—I prefer problems with hinges.
dialogue.bell-vault: The robed one carries a bronze key. Give me ten breaths and a distraction.
